title: The Booking for Appointments and Events Calendar – Amelia Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to time-based SQL…
description: The Booking for Appointments and Events Calendar – Amelia Pro plugin for WordPress contains a time-based SQL Injection vulnerability in the 'tag[] (array KEYS)' parameter. This affects all versions up to and including 9.9.1. The flaw arises from insufficient escaping of user-supplied array keys, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject additional SQL queries and potentially extract sensitive database information.
